claimChecks.claim: Microsurgical replantation universally restores appearance, voiding, erections and sensation
claimChecks.locator: ACS penile-amputation management; Wang abstract Results; recovery source limits
claimChecks.note: Urgent microsurgery is preferred when feasible, but outcomes and complications vary and the evidence is mostly cases/small series.

claimChecks.claim: The Wang sequence, one-dorsal-artery minimum and a fixed optimal vessel set are universal requirements
claimChecks.locator: ACS repair principles and Wang one-case abstract/video citation
claimChecks.note: Sequence labeled case-specific; repair targets depend on injury anatomy and no fixed count guarantees survival.

claimChecks.claim: Microsurgical versus macroscopic complication and functional rates are reliably established
claimChecks.locator: ACS macroscopic fallback; unresolved heterogeneous primary series
claimChecks.note: Table now reports patterns without rare/common/normal-most rates or an unsupported comparative effect.
Outcome wording is explicitly author-reported for the cited protocol/case.

claimChecks.claim: Leeches, HBO and antithrombotics are proven routine salvage therapies
claimChecks.locator: Individual retained case citations; no comparative package recovered
claimChecks.note: Adjuncts are described as individualized case strategies with unestablished comparative benefit.

claimChecks.claim: Every retained vessel measurement, suture size, case outcome, pediatric statement and adjunct regimen has complete source verification

claimChecks.claim: Five penile transplants and two explantations is a current global registry total
claimChecks.note: Accurate only as the historical experience summarized by the 2023 review; page already preserves that date boundary.

claimChecks.claim: All five historical cases had vascular complications
claimChecks.note: The review reports vascular congestion and/or hematoma requiring intervention in all five and necrosis in all but one; citation corrected from a cadaveric anatomy study.

claimChecks.claim: Knoedler's rejection percentages estimate penile-VCA risk
claimChecks.locator: Abstract, patient-demographics results, penile treatment result and limitations
claimChecks.note: The 136-recipient cohort included only one penile VCA; aggregate and overlapping event data are now labeled all-VCA only.

claimChecks.claim: Cadaveric gender-affirming/anterior-pubic-osteotomy models establish clinical indications and outcomes
claimChecks.locator: Current page source identities and preserved 2023 anatomy-study descriptions
claimChecks.note: Both are explicitly preclinical anatomical feasibility evidence.

claimChecks.claim: Tacrolimus monotherapy demonstrates tolerance and the Cape Town regimen is a standard protocol
claimChecks.locator: Abstract, key points and immunosuppression discussion
claimChecks.note: Monotherapy is immunosuppression minimization, not tolerance; dosing/prophylaxis remain case-specific.

claimChecks.claim: Natural conception represents donor fertility and VCA has no donor-site ethical burden
claimChecks.note: Conception used recipient gonads; VCA avoids a recipient autologous flap site but still involves deceased-donor recovery and family ethics.

claimChecks.claim: Every retained operative, immunosuppression, outcome, complication and preclinical detail has complete primary-source verification
claimChecks.locator: Outstanding Redett, Cape Town, MGH and anatomy/preclinical source packages
